name: Industry and Next Action columns display legitimate empty states based on API contract
description:
Objective: Industry and Next Action columns display legitimate empty states based on API contract.
Preconditions: Open Applications with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Applications.
2. Industry and Next Action columns display legitimate empty states based on API contract.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Industry shows the API industry name, and '-' only when it is absent.
